name: 메타데이터 분석
description: Examines EXIF data, file naming patterns, and resolution for signs of AI generation tools. Checks for camera make/model, GPS data, and software markers like Stable Diffusion or DALL-E.
mechanism:
The 메타데이터 분석 system operates in multiple stages:

1. **Data Extraction**: Reads all EXIF (Exchangeable Image File Format), XMP (Extensible Metadata Platform), and IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) 메타데이터 fields embedded in the image.

2. **Camera Verification**: 조사합니다 Make, Model, LensModel fields to verify the capture device. AI images typically lack or contain fabricated camera information.

3. **Software Detection**: 식별합니다 Software, CreatorTool, HistorySoftwareAgent tags containing AI tool names 와 같은 'Stable Diffusion', 'DALL-E', 'Midjourney', 'Adobe Firefly'.

4. **Timestamp Validation**: Cross-references DateTimeOriginal, DateTimeDigitized, ModifyDate 감지하기 위해 temporal 이상.

5. **GPS Analysis**: 확인합니다 GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude — AI images rarely contain authentic GPS coordinates.
parameters:
Primary EXIF fields: Make, Model, Software, GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude, DateTimeOriginal, ColorSpace, ExifVersion, XMP:CreatorTool, XMP:History, IPTC:DigitalSourceType

Detected AI tools: Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ComfyUI, Automatic1111, InvokeAI

Metadata standards: EXIF 2.32 (JEITA CP-3451), Adobe XMP 2.0, IPTC PMD 2024.1
accuracy: 높음 - 85-95% when 메타데이터 is present and unstripped. However, many social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram) automatically strip 메타데이터 on upload, reducing effectiveness.
source: JEITA CP-3451 (Exif 2.32), Adobe XMP Specification, IPTC Photo Metadata Standard
useCase: First-pass triage: quickly 식별 images with AI software tags, missing authentic camera 메타데이터, or inconsistent 메타데이터. This is the first step in the 분석 pipeline due to its speed and low computational cost.

references.title: JEITA CP-3451C — Exchangeable Image File Format (Exif) Version 2.32
Adobe XMP Specification Part 1: Data Model, Serialization, and Core Properties
C2PA Technical Specification — Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2011). A Perceptual Metric for Photo Retouching. PNAS.
Gloe, T. & Böhme, R. (2010). The Dresden Image Database for Benchmarking Digital Image Forensics. ACM SAC.

strengths:
• Extremely fast 분석 time (< 10ms per image)
• No pixel decoding required, only reads file headers
• High 정확도 when 메타데이터 is intact
• Can identify specific AI tools through software tags
• Compliant with international standards (EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA)
limitations:
• Metadata can be easily stripped or forged
• Many social media platforms auto-strip 메타데이터 on upload
• Cannot detect AI images that have had 메타데이터 removed
• Depends on whether AI tools embed software tags
